item.title: 13k-Mile 2018 Mercedes-Benz E400 4MATIC Wagon
item.description: This 2018 Mercedes-Benz E400 4MATIC wagon is a Luxury Line example finished in Piedmont Green Metallic over Black MB-Tex. It has 13k miles following history with the original owner in Georgia until 2026. Power is provided by a 329-horsepower twin-turbocharged 3.0L V6 that drives all four wheels through a nine-speed automatic transmission. item.title: 2015 Rolls-Royce Ghost
item.description: This 2015 Rolls-Royce Ghost is finished in English White and has been retrofitted with revised Mansory body panels. Power comes from a twin-turbocharged 6.6-liter V12 linked with an eight-speed automatic transmission, and the car rides on self-leveling air springs as well as custom 22" alloy wheels. item.title: 2010 BMW 328i M Sport Convertible 6-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 2010 BMW 328i convertible remained under the care of its original owner until the seller's recent purchase in 2026, and it was specified with a six-speed manual transmission, as well as the M Sport, Premium, and Cold Weather Packages. Finished in Black Sapphire Metallic over Coral Red Dakota leather upholstery, the car is powered by a 3.0-liter inline-six. item.title: Beck Speedster
item.description: This Porsche 356 Speedster replica was manufactured by Beck and was assembled in 2011 by Special Edition, Inc. of Bremen, Indiana. item.description: This 2004 Mercedes-Benz CLK320 cabriolet has 56k miles following registration history in Florida, and it remained in the same owner's care from January 2006 until earlier this year. The car is finished in Firemist Red Metallic over Ash leather and is powered by a 3.2-liter V6 paired with a five-speed automatic transmission. item.description: This 1961 Checker Superba is a six-person station wagon that was sold directly to its Kalamazoo, Michigan-based first owner, and it is said to have remained in their family and covered over 300k miles until it was donated to the seller, the Gilmore Car Museum, in 2021. item.title: 1,800-Mile, Guardsman Blue 1999 Shelby Series 1
item.description: This 1999 Shelby Series 1 is believed to be the only production example finished in Guardsman Blue metallic paint with Wimbledon White over-the-top stripes and was specified from the factory with the X50 package, which added revised camshafts to the Oldsmobile-based 4.0L quad-cam V8 engine. item.title: 1989 Porsche 911 Speedster
item.description: This 1989 Porsche 911 Speedster is one of 823 US-market examples produced for the model year. It has remained registered in Arizona for over two decades and was acquired by the selling dealer in 2016. Powered by a 3.2-liter flat-six paired with a G50 five-speed manual transaxle, the car is finished in black over black leather upholstery.
